final_message:
Fixed. Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The change is in `src/blog/slug.js`. Before slugifying, `postSlug` decomposes the title (NFD) and strips the combining accent marks. I left `vendor/` untouched.

The shop's `productUrl` also calls the vendor `slugify` directly, so product URLs will still drop accented letters. I didn't change it because you asked about blog posts. If you want it fixed too, it needs the same normalization, which I can add in `src/shop/product-url.js`.

I didn't commit anything.
